contradictionsWithTheApp: Site /stake and /token describe staking, buybacks and burns in the present tense. In the application, Staking is a Coming Soon page.
Site /models claims 200+ models. The live picker holds 133: 64 text, 35 image, 34 video.
Site /private carries blanket zero-retention language. The app exposes four distinct privacy badges whose guarantees differ by route.
Site home advertises unlimited text and image generation on Pro. Terms permit credits, rate limits and overages.
